formula: DR_Armor = Armor / (Armor + 50 * Attacker_Level); At Level 70: DR_Armor = Armor / (Armor + 3500); Factor_Armor = 1 - DR_Armor = 3500 / (Armor + 3500)
effect_type: Percentage damage reduction applied to all incoming physical and elemental damage.
stacking_behavior: Multiplicative with all other mitigation layers. Base gear armor flat armor rolls Strength (1:1) and Dexterity (1:1) add together then multiply by (1 + % Armor).
notes: 10 Armor provides the exact same damage reduction as 1 All Resistance (10:1 ratio).; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

formula: DR_Res = Resistance / (Resistance + 5 * Attacker_Level); At Level 70: DR_Res = Resistance / (Resistance + 350); Factor_Res = 1 - DR_Res = 350 / (Resistance + 350)
effect_type: Percentage damage reduction applied to damage matching that specific elemental resistance (Physical Fire Cold Lightning Poison Arcane/Holy).
stacking_behavior: Multiplicative with Armor and other mitigation layers. All Resistance from gear Diamonds Paragon passives and Intelligence (0.1 per point) add together; secondary single resists add for that specific element.
notes: Character sheet Toughness uses the average of all 6 elemental resistances (Res_Avg).; Numeric columns transcribed from existing formula_for_effect/cap_or_soft_cap/how_it_stacks prose (mitigation: formula); Codex literal audit phase 2 B.

formula: DR_Class = 0.30 (for Barbarian Crusader Monk); DR_Class = 0.00 (for Demon Hunter Necromancer Witch Doctor Wizard); Factor_Class = 0.70 (melee) or 1.00 (ranged/caster)
effect_type: Permanent flat 30% damage reduction against all incoming damage types for melee classes.
stacking_behavior: Multiplicative with all other mitigation layers.
notes: Inherent baseline passive trait for Barbarians Crusaders and Monks to offset melee vulnerability.

formula: DR_Specific = 1 - Product_i(1 - DR_i); Factor_Specific = Product_i(1 - DR_i)
effect_type: Percentage damage reduction from item powers set bonuses and active skills (e.g. Band of Might 80% Aquila Cuirass 50% Unity 50% Wrath of the Wastes 4pc 50% Endless Walk 50% Elite DR Melee/Ranged DR).
stacking_behavior: Multiplicative across all distinct sources (diminishing returns on percentage DR).
notes: Secondary item affixes (Melee/Ranged DR up to 7% per piece) and Elite DR (Chest Aughild's) multiply into this factor.

effect_type: Probabilistic avoidance check. On success the player takes 0 damage and avoids on-hit debuffs from direct attacks.
stacking_behavior: Multiplicative across dodge sources (skills passives like Sixth Sense/Guardian's Path War Cry Veteran's Warning Gogok of Swiftness).
notes: Ground affix hazards (Plagued Molten explosion/trail Arcane Sentry beams Desecrator Thunderstorm) cannot be dodged. Factored into sheet Toughness as: Toughness = EHP / (1 - Total_Dodge).

formula: Damage_Taken = Max(0 Incoming_Damage - Block_Amount); Block_Amount = Random(Min_Block Max_Block)
effect_type: Flat subtractive damage reduction applied when a physical/melee/ranged attack is blocked (Block Chance soft cap 75% on sheet hard cap 100% with buffs).
stacking_behavior: Block chance adds additively up to 75% sheet cap. Flat block amount subtracts directly from incoming damage after all percentage DR layers.
notes: Because Block reduces damage by a flat amount (not a percentage) it does not scale linearly against high Greater Rift hits and is excluded from standard character sheet Toughness (except via Justice Lantern ring which converts Block Chance into percentage DR: DR% = Block_Chance% * Justice_Lantern_Roll%).

formula: Total_Damage_Taken_Factor = Factor_Armor * Factor_Res * Factor_Class * Factor_Specific; Total_DR% = (1 - Total_Damage_Taken_Factor) * 100
effect_type: Total percentage of incoming raw damage absorbed before Life or Block is affected.
stacking_behavior: Strictly multiplicative across all independent mitigation layers. Total damage taken is the product of all remaining damage fractions.
notes: Every 50% DR multiplier doubles Effective Health Pool regardless of how much DR is already possessed.

effect_type: Effective Health Pool (EHP) representing the raw unmitigated damage a character can sustain before dying.
stacking_behavior: Scales linearly with Maximum Life and inversely with the product of all damage-taken multipliers and (1 - Dodge).
notes: Calculated in-game using Res_Avg across all 6 elemental damage types.
